details:
I have 2 sets of Index controllers that I switch between when one set runs out of charge. 
Recently, I think since this patch https://steamcommunity.com/games/250820/announcements/detail/3200377990387557292, the second set of controllers will not work if they are powered on while the SteamVR menu is enabled. Controllers do work perfectly while in SteamVR menu itself, just not in VRChat. It seems that the bindings are not applied correctly since none of the VRChat binds work but for example the system button and OVR Advanced Settings bindings still work. 
Workaround exists: power up the new controllers without SteamVR menu on. If controllers were turned on while SteamVR menu was on, power cycle them without it and they will work.
Reproduction:
1. Pair 2 sets of Index controllers
2. Start VRChat
3. Open SteamVR menu with the system button
4. Turn off the first set of controllers
5. Power on the second set of controllers
6. Close SteamVR menu
7. Controllers don't work
8. Turn the second set of controllers off and on again while not in SteamVR menu
9. Controllers now work in VRChat

Edit: I'm on SteamVR beta, currently 1.22.5
title: Second set of Index controllers won't work if they are turned on while in SteamVR menu
